violated_contract: A temporary loss of call evidence may close the capture gate but must not irreversibly finalize a confirmed logical meeting before a bounded same-call resume window has elapsed
canonical_prevention: Separate provisional capture, confirmed meeting identity and finalization. Resume matching identities inside a bounded window without rotating; expire at the original off edge. Preserve confirmed-app evidence hysteresis, pending notices, cloud lifetime and final ASR draining across that window. Resolve interrupted-meeting provenance before creating a relaunch session.
